OPERATIVE REPORT

Procedure: AVR (#25 CE), aortic valve replacement with bioprosthesis via sternotomy.

Preoperative Diagnosis: Severe native aortic stenosis with a heavily calcified trileaflet
valve.

A standard median sternotomy was performed and cardiopulmonary bypass instituted. The
native valve was excised and the annulus was sized to accommodate a #25 CE valve, which
was implanted using interrupted pledgeted sutures.

Following separation from bypass, intraoperative echocardiography showed the mean gradient
is 9 mmHg with no significant paravalvular leak. The patient was transferred to the
intensive care unit in stable condition.
